summary: Feed s093_single is degraded: 10.2% of frames (333/3260) exceed the SIEM's 1518-byte MTU and are dropped at the NIC, causing systematic visibility loss.

findings.root_cause: Network segments are forwarding jumbo frames up to 8058 bytes, but the SIEM's 1 Gbps capture port is limited to standard 1518-byte Ethernet MTU with no jumbo-frame support. The packet broker is passing frames through unchanged.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM NIC drops all frames >1518 bytes before analysis - 10.2% loss (333/3260 frames). Results in missing events/flows and incomplete detection/correlation; largest dropped frames 8058 bytes.

recommended_fix.why: Enable 9000-byte jumbo MTU on SIEM capture NIC/port and intervening broker egress, or alternatively configure broker to slice/fragment to 1518 bytes (SIEM needs_full_payload=false so slicing is safe) to prevent NIC-level drops.
